text:
meera: quick design review request — API Keys page. Focus areas: empty state CTA, rotate modal copy, revoke confirmation, and a11y nits. Posting mocks and copy suggestions in thread. PTAL. 👀

dan: skimmed the mock. two quick instincts: 1) the empty state CTA text — should we use 'Create your first API key' or 'Generate API key'? 2) rotate modal has long paragraph; maybe break into bulleted benefits/warnings.

alex: I vote for 'Create your first API key' — matches Projects and Datasets pages. For rotate modal, split into: - why rotate - what breaks (clients) - action + fallback. Short and scannable.

kat: accessibility nits: modal needs focus trap and initial focus on the new key input. Close button must have an explicit aria-label. Also ensure the masked key copy button triggers an aria-live region announcing "Key copied to clipboard".

meera: agreed. I'll update Figma. Also thinking about masked preview: show the last 4 chars, with a small 'show' toggle for keyboard users. Copy suggestion for show toggle aria: `aria-pressed` + label toggling between 'Show key' and 'Hide key'.

dan: permissions UX — current dropdown says 'Permissions (optional)'. People misread it as roles. Suggest 'Access scope' or 'Role' and show inline examples like 'Embeddings only, Read-only, Full'. Could we surface a least-privilege warning when selecting broader scopes?

alex: wording for revoke confirmation: current: "Are you sure you want to revoke this key?" Proposed: "Revoke this key? This will immediately stop all apps using it. This cannot be undone." Slightly stronger but clearer. Maybe add a small 'How to recover' line linking to docs.

kat: color/contrast check for empty state CTA — the blue on the illustration caption is <4.5:1 on some screens. We need to ensure button meets 4.5:1 and that the illustration does not convey critical info (required for screen readers). Add an off-screen text description for the illustration.

meera: copy tweak for rotate modal body: propose bullets under header: - New key will replace the old one after you confirm. - You will have 60 minutes to update integrations (preview only). - Old key remains valid until you click 'Finalize rotation'. (we can change times)

dan: small technical ask: expose 'expires_at' field in the list view so users can scan for soon-to-expire keys (UI: column with relative time and color indicator). That helps with rotation prompts.

alex: empty state microcopy idea: header 'Secure your app with an API key' body 'Create an API key to start calling Redwood. You control scopes and rotation.' CTA: 'Create API key' secondary: 'Learn about best practices' (links to docs).

meera: action items: - meera: update Figma + new copy (by Thursday EOD) - dan: wire up 'expires_at' column spec and scope labels (by Friday) - kat: produce accessibility checklist and aria labels snippet (Thursday) - alex: final review of revoke + rotate microcopy (Friday AM)

ui-bot: Reminder: Design review follow-up scheduled Thu 10/24 09:00 AM — calendar invite sent.

meera: thanks everyone — I'll drop the updated frames and a copy diff here when ready. :thumbsup:
